newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Siu-Fung sees no impact from unit closure.
newsitem.headline: Siu-Fung sees no impact from unit closure.

text.p: Siu-Fung Ceramics Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday the cessation of operations at a plant in Selb, Germany, and the liquidation of its indirectly wholly-owned Netzsch Selb unit were not expected to have any material financial impact on the company.

"Neither the company nor any of its subsidiaries is expected to suffer any financial loss arising out of the cessation of operations and liquidation," the company's chairman Siegfried Lee said in the statement.

Lee also said they would not have a material impact on the company's long term business strategies and objectives, and its plan of seeking a separate listing of one of the company's subsidiaries in the United States.
The company shares's, which fell HK$0.16 or 17.39 percent on Monday, edged up two cents to HK$0.78 in mid-morning.

Last Friday, the ceramics and machinery maker said it was reorganising its German subsidiaries and had decided to close a loss-making plant in Selb operated by Netzsch Selb, a member of the Netzsch group operating ceramics business in Germnay, Italy and the U.K. acquired by Siu-fung in March 1996.
Siu-Fung estimated the closure would save about HK$300 million a year in costs. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
